81531.subject: Sexually transmitted infections are surging in Europe
81531.body:
The Economist Picks

Автор: The Economist


Автор: The Economist

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/sexually-transmitted-infections-surging-europe-the-economist-71xhe?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3Bggsi7dMuSOaRF%2FrVQHvZwg%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=3VyjEZOfsp2sw1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mvs2sgj5~kz-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mvs2sgj5-kz
  
Tracking sexually transmitted infections is notoriously difficult. Testing is patchy and people tend not to be forthcoming with their doctors about their sexual habits. But public-health authorities do their best. And in Europe data show a concerning rise in syphilis and gonorrhoea. Several culprits have been suggested, with varying degrees of plausibility: dating apps, a growing aversion to condoms and the rise of pre-exposure prophylaxis, a pill that fights the spread of HIV. Slowing down the transmission of STIs will be tricky, but there are already encouraging signs. You’ll also get our weekly newsletter with an exclusive introduction from our senior editors. 🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin steadies above $81K as markets brace for the Fed, while Washington doubles down on stablecoins and Robinhood's crypto slump exposes cooling retail appetite. 📈 Bitcoin Reclaims $81K Ahead of Fed Decision Bitcoin climbed to around $81,400 after slipping below $80,000 on Tuesday, lifted by a rebound in Asian chip stocks as South Korea's Kospi jumped 6.6% and SK Hynix surged on a sevenfold profit jump. U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs took in $176 million on Tuesday, a second straight day of inflows. CME FedWatch puts the odds of an unchanged rate at about 92%, with the decision due at 18:00 UTC and traders focused on Chair Kevin Warsh's guidance. Read full story 🇺🇸 Bessent: Crypto Will Fortify the U.S. Dollar Speaking at Ripple's Swell conference, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent framed digital assets as part of the U.S.-China technology race, saying America will "win in the digital asset stack." He argued dollar-backed stablecoins could become an important source of demand for Treasury debt, and said Treasury will work with the SEC and CFTC to fill the gap left by the failed Clarity Act and set guardrails against crypto debanking. More details ⚖️ CFTC Sues Utah to Shield Kalshi's Prediction Markets The Commodity Futures Trading Commission filed a federal challenge to block Utah's attorney general from stopping Kalshi's event contracts in the state, where gambling is constitutionally banned. Chairman Mike Selig argues federal authority preempts state law; the agency is now fighting 10 states in court as appellate rulings remain split on who regulates prediction markets. Read more 📉 Robinhood's Crypto Revenue Plunges 55% Robinhood's Q3 crypto transaction revenue fell to $120 million from about $267 million a year earlier, though it beat the $114.1 million consensus. Crypto trading volume dropped 38% to $50 billion, and crypto now makes up just 8.4% of total revenue of $1.42 billion. Prediction markets brought in $173 million, while overall EPS missed forecasts and shares slid about 5% after hours. See details 🤝 Robinhood Brings Ripple's RLUSD to Retail App Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin, now above $2.5 billion in market cap, will become available in the Robinhood app before the end of 2026, potentially reaching its 28.6 million funded customers.
